title: 在中国，咖啡师是国家认证的正经职业 | Barista Is an Official Job in China ☕
description:
你的城市，咖啡师算体面工作吗？评论区聊聊。

在中国，「咖啡师」早已是国家认证的正经职业：人社部组织制定了《咖啡师国家职业技能标准（2022 年版）》，职业编码 4-03-02-08，从五级/初级工一路到一级/高级技师，共五个等级。而 2025 年，咖啡的职业版图又扩了一块——5 月人社部公示第七批新职业，17 个新职业加 42 个新工种里就有「咖啡加工工」（把咖啡鲜果加工成生豆、熟豆的人），并于 7 月 22 日正式发布。从一颗鲜果到一杯拉花，每一步都有了专门的工种。一杯咖啡背后，其实是一整条职业链。

In China, being a barista is an officially recognized occupation: the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security issued the National Occupational Skill Standard for Baristas (2022 edition), occupation code 4-03-02-08, spanning five levels from junior worker up to senior technician. And in 2025 the coffee career map grew again — in May the ministry published its seventh batch of new occupations (17 new jobs plus 42 new job types), including "coffee-processing worker" (people who turn fresh cherries into green and roasted beans), formally released on July 22. From cherry to latte art, each step is now its own trade — a whole career ladder behind a single cup.

Facts only, no endorsement. AI-assisted edit; the subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
